HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #4
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   D. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   C. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   B. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

   C. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

9. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)

   B. Use Basic Prayers to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
